label: Open the photo with the pale trousers. Click Darkroom.
Scroll down the editing panel to Color match.
Click Add area to open the photo and its product references.
In Photo, click the pale denim on the left thigh.
In Reference, click the indigo denim to set the target color.
Check the blue across both legs, then click Done.
Try Amount 50 for a softer correction.
Return Amount to 100 for the full correction.
Set Tone to 0 to keep the lightness of the original trousers.
Return Tone to 100 to match the darker indigo reference.
Scroll down to compare the result.
Hold Before to see the pale denim. Release to see the indigo.
Click PNG to download the corrected photo.
